services.name: Camp
services.desc: The Nave Museum is collaborating with The Vine School to bring their students fun and engaging art activities! These classes will take place right after school is over. Students will get to work with a variety of mediums such as clay, paint, crafts, snack-making, and so much more! This is a program for Vine School students only! Children from any of The Vine School's programs are welcome to attend. Classes are held every Monday or Thursday (depending on age group) during the semester, 2:15 - 3 pm, in the Vine School main campus. $50 per child to register. Spots are limited, so be sure to register your child today! Within the message box at the bottom, please include the following details

blurb: Join us for an unforgettable cocktail event, with heavy tapas, live entertainment, signature drinks, and a silent auction. Artists will create festive retablo paintings in the spirit of the season that will be up for auction on the event night!
